mapper.select: select c.category_name as name, count(*) as value from product p join category c on p.category_id = c.category_id group by c.category_name order by value desc
select c.category_name as name, round(avg(p.price), 2) as value from product p join category c on p.category_id = c.category_id group by c.category_name order by value desc
select date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m') as name, count(*) as value from orders where order_status = 'COMPLETED' group by date_format(order_time, '%Y-%m') order by name

select sum(case when price <50 then 1 else 0 end) as below50, sum(case when price >= 50 and price <200 then 1 else 0 end) as between50And200, sum(case when price >= 200 and price <500 then 1 else 0 end) as between200And500, sum(case when price >= 500 then 1 else 0 end) as above500 from product
select u.username as name, count(p.product_id) as value from sys_user u left join product p on u.user_id = p.user_id group by u.user_id, u.username order by value desc limit 10
